title: A Formal Methodological Framework for Auditing Robustness and Fidelity in Explainable AI: From Application to Trust Certification
abstract: arXiv:2608.23817v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: SHAP and LIME are now standard tools for interpreting black-box predictions, yet their outputs can vary substantially when the input is perturbed by small amounts of noise--a problem we observed firsthand in our previous work on food security in Madagascar (Ralinirina et al., 2025). This variability raises the question of whether such explanations can be trusted at all. We address it by constructing an auditing protocol that measures two properties of any post-hoc explainer: robustness (how stable the explanation is under input perturbation) and fidelity (whether the features deemed important actually drive the model's prediction). These two quantities are combined into a single Trust Score. We run the protocol on a multi-sectoral dataset from Madagascar (83 features, 253 records, 4 malnutrition classes) using three classifiers and two explainers, plus their regularized counterparts. The results are sobering: models with AUC above 0.99 c

translated_title: 一种用于审计可解释人工智能鲁棒性与保真度的形式化方法框架：从应用到信任认证
translated_abstract: 摘要：SHAP和LIME现已成为解释黑盒预测的标准工具，然而当输入被微小噪声扰动时，它们的输出可能发生显著变化——这一问题是我们在之前关于马达加斯加粮食安全的研究中（Ralinirina等人，2025）直接观察到的。这种变异性引发了一个问题：此类解释是否可以被信任。我们通过构建一个审计协议来解决这一问题，该协议衡量任何事后解释器的两个属性：鲁棒性（解释在输入扰动下的稳定性）和保真度（被认为重要的特征是否确实驱动模型的预测）。这两个量被合并为一个单一的信任分数。我们在来自马达加斯加的多部门数据集（83个特征，253条记录，4个营养不良类别）上运行该协议，使用三种分类器和两种解释器，及其正则化版本。结果令人警醒：AUC超过0.99的模型。
tldr: 本文提出了一种形式化审计框架，通过结合鲁棒性和保真度计算信任分数，系统评估SHAP和LIME等事后解释器的可靠性，并在马达加斯加实际数据集上验证，发现高AUC模型仍可能产生不可信的解释。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a formal auditing framework that computes a trust score by combining robustness and fidelity to systematically evaluate the reliability of post-hoc explainers like SHAP and LIME, validated on real-world Madagascar data, revealing that high-AUC models can still yield untrustworthy explanations.
